# Web3 Icons

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/README.md

![Web3 Icons](https://web3icons.io/og-image.png)

# Web3 Icons

![Tokens](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?style=flat&color=FF3D00&label=tokens&query=length&url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/main/packages/common/src/metadata/tokens.json) ![Networks](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?style=flat&color=FF3D00&label=networks&query=length&url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/main/packages/common/src/metadata/networks.json) ![Wallets](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?style=flat&color=FF3D00&label=wallets&query=length&url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/main/packages/common/src/metadata/wallets.json) ![Exchanges](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?style=flat&color=FF3D00&label=exchanges&query=length&url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/main/packages/common/src/metadata/exchanges.json) ![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40web3icons%2Freact?style=flat&label=%40web3icons%2Freact) ![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40web3icons%2Fcore?style=flat&label=%40web3icons%2Fcore)

Web3 Icons is the most comprehensive and up-to-date source for tokens, coins, networks and wallet logos as icon format. More than 2,500 icons are ready as optimized SVGs as well as React components.

- All of the icons are carefully curated by hand.
- `type` refers to `wallet`, `token`, `network` and `exchange`
- `variant` refers to `mono`, `branded`, and `background` (not every icon comes with all variants, but the vast majority have at least `mono` or `branded` and all icons have `background` variants)

> Find the data table of all supported icons [here](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/docs/icons.md)

### Website

The Web3 Icons website ([https://web3icons.io](https://web3icons.io/)) provides a searchable collection of all available icons. You can browse, search, and download icons directly from the website.

### Contributing

We welcome contributions to `web3icons`! If you'd like to contribute, please refer to our [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

### Monorepo structure

- [`@web3icons/core`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/tree/main/packages/core): npm package that serves optimized svgs as svg files
- [`@web3icons/react`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/tree/main/packages/react): React components for web3 icons
- [`@web3icons/common`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/tree/main/packages/common): Shared metadata and types
- [`scripts/`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/tree/main/scripts): Build scripts, CLI tools, and maintenance utilities
- [`apps/website`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/tree/main/apps/website): Next.js app for https://web3icons.io
- [`apps/figma-plugin`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/tree/main/apps/figma-plugin): Figma plugin for web3 icons

## Installation

To use Web3 Icons in your project, you can install the necessary packages from npm:

```
npm i @web3icons/core @web3icons/react
```

```
yarn add @web3icons/core @web3icons/react
```

```
bun i @web3icons/core @web3icons/react
```

> [!NOTE]
> You can install either of the packages based on your project's needs.

# `@web3icons/react`

### Tree-shaking

Individual icon components from `@web3icons/react` are tree-shakable, meaning that only the icons you explicitly import will be included in your bundle. This helps reduce bundle size and improve performance.

> **Note:** Dynamic components (`<TokenIcon />`, `<NetworkIcon />`, `<WalletIcon />`, `<ExchangeIcon />`) are **NOT tree-shakable**. They load icons on-demand at runtime using dynamic imports. For optimal bundle size, use individual icon components instead.

## Usage

There are two main ways to use any icon your project needs in a React environment. You can individually import the components or you can import the dynamic component for each `type` of the icons.

1. [Using Individual React Components](#using-individual-components)
2. [Using Dynamic Components](#using-dynamic-components)
   1. `<TokenIcon />`
   2. `<NetworkIcon />`
   3. `<WalletIcon />`
   4. `<ExchangeIcon />`

### Using Individual Components

All the icons from the React library are prefixed with `Token`, `Network`, `Wallet`, or `Exchange`

### Props Overview

All of the components extend the [`SVGSVGElement`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/SVGSVGElement) and accepts a `size` prop as number or string.

- **`variant?`**: Determines the style of the icon. Options: `'mono'`, `'branded'`, or `'background'`. Default is `'mono'`.
- **`size?`**: Specifies the size of the icon. It can be a string or a number.
- **`color?`**: Specifies the color of the icon. Accepts any valid CSS color value.
- **`className?`**: Adds a custom CSS class to the icon for additional styling.

### Tokens

[List of all the available tokens](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/docs/icons.md#tokens)

Cryptocurrency coins and tokens, the react components are prefixed with `Token`, followed by uppercase symbol. `TokenETH`, `TokenBTC`, `TokenGRT`

### Networks

[List of all the available networks](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/docs/icons.md#networks)

Networks and chains, react components are prefixed with `Network` followed by the PascalCase name of the network. `NetworkBinanceSmartChain`, `NetworkEthereum`, `NetworkAvalanche`

### Wallets

[List of all the available wallets](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/docs/icons.md#wallets)

Crypto wallets, react components are prefixed with `Wallet` followed by the PascalCase name of the wallet. `WalletRainbow`, `WalletMetamask`, `WalletCoinbase`

### Exchanges

[List of all the available exchanges](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/docs/icons.md#exchanges)

Crypto exchanges, react components are prefixed with `Exchange` followed by the PascalCase name of the exchange. `ExchangeBybit`, `ExchangePancakeSwap`, `ExchangeBalancer`

```jsx
import {
  TokenBTC,
  TokenETH,
  TokenGRT,
  NetworkBinanceSmartChain,
  NetworkEthereum,
  NetworkAvalanche,
  WalletLedger,
  WalletMetamask,
  WalletSafe,
  ExchangeBybit,
  ExchangePancakeSwap,
  ExchangeBalancer,
} from '@web3icons/react'

const App = () => {
  return (
    <>
      <div>
        {/* Token Icons */}
        <TokenBTC size={64} variant="branded" className="my-custom-class" />
        <TokenETH size={64} variant="branded" className="my-custom-class" />
        <TokenGRT size={64} variant="branded" className="my-custom-class" />
      </div>
      <div>
        {/* Network Icons */}
        <NetworkEthereum
          size={64}
          variant="branded"
          className="my-custom-class"
        />
        <NetworkAvalanche
          size={64}
          variant="branded"
          className="my-custom-class"
        />
        <NetworkBinanceSmartChain
          size={64}
          variant="branded"
          className="my-custom-class"
        />
      </div>
      <div>
        {/* Wallet Icons */}
        <WalletLedger size={64} variant="branded" className="my-custom-class" />
        <WalletMetamask
          size={64}
          variant="branded"
          className="my-custom-class"
        />
        <WalletSafe size={64} variant="branded" className="my-custom-class" />
      </div>
      <div>
        {/* Exchange Icons */}
        <ExchangeBybit
          size={64}
          variant="branded"
          className="my-custom-class"
        />
        <ExchangeBalancer
          size={64}
          variant="branded"
          className="my-custom-class"
        />
        <ExchangePancakeSwap
          size={64}
          variant="branded"
          className="my-custom-class"
        />
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

export default App
```

## Using Dynamic Components

All of the Dynamic Components are designed to provide ease of use, they accept various custom props which allow the component to correctly import the desired icon.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Dynamic components are available from the `/dynamic` entry point and are **client-side only** and are **not tree-shakable**. They use React hooks and dynamic imports to load icons at runtime. For better bundle optimization and server component compatibility, use individual icon components instead.
>
> ```jsx
> // ✅ Dynamic components (client-side only)
> import { TokenIcon, NetworkIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'
>
> // ✅ Static components (server-safe, tree-shakable)
> import { TokenBTC, NetworkEthereum } from '@web3icons/react'
> ```

### Shared Props Overview

- **`variant?`**: Determines the style of the icon. Options: `'mono'`, `'branded'`, or `'background'`. Defaults to `'mono'`.
- **`size?`**: Specifies the size of the icon. It can be a string or a number.
- **`color?`**: Specifies the color of the icon. Accepts any valid CSS color value.
- **`className?`**: Adds a custom CSS class to the icon for additional styling.
- **`fallback?`**: Fallback content to display if the icon cannot be found. Can be a string (URL) or a ReactNode.

## `<TokenIcon />`

### Props

These properties are used specifically for token icons. You must provide either the `symbol` prop or both `address` and `network` props together.

- **`symbol`**: The ticker symbol of the token (e.g., `'ETH'`, `'BTC'`). _If `symbol` is provided, `address` and `network` should not be provided._
- **`address`**: The contract address of the token. _Must be used with the `network` prop._
- **`network`**: The blockchain network where the token is deployed (e.g., `'ethereum'`, `'bsc'`). _Must be used with the `address` prop._

### Example Usage

```jsx
import { TokenIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'

// Renders Ethereum icon in mono variant
<TokenIcon symbol="eth" size={32} color="#000" />

// Renders GRT icon in branded variant
<TokenIcon address="0xc944e90c64b2c07662a292be6244bdf05cda44a7" network="ethereum" size="2rem" />
```

## `<NetworkIcon />`

`<NetworkIcon />` tries to find a match comparing the passed `network` value with the `id` or `name` or `shortName` from the [`networks.json`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/packages/common/src/metadata/networks.json)

### Props

- **`network`**: The blockchain network (e.g., `'ethereum'`, `'bsc'`).

### Example Usage

```jsx
import { NetworkIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'

// from networks.json:
// {
// "id": "binance-smart-chain",
// "name": "BNB Smart Chain",
// "shortname": "BSC",
// "nativeCoinId": "binancecoin",
// "variants": ["branded", "mono", "background"]
// }

<NetworkIcon network="bsc" size={32} variant="branded" /> // matches the shortname
<NetworkIcon network="binance-smart-chain" size={32} variant="branded" /> // matches the id
<NetworkIcon network="bnb smart chain" size={32} variant="branded" /> // matches the name
```

## `<WalletIcon />`

`<WalletIcon />` tries to find a match comparing the passed `name` value with the `id` or `name` from the [`wallets.json`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/packages/common/src/metadata/wallets.json)

```jsx
import { WalletIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'

// from wallets.json:
// {
// "id": "wallet-connect",
// "name": "Wallet Connect",
// "variants": ["branded", "mono", "background"]
// }

<WalletIcon name="wallet-connect" size={32} variant="branded" /> // matches the id
<WalletIcon name="wallet connect" size={32} variant="branded" /> // matches the name

```

## `<ExchangeIcon />`

`<ExchangeIcon />` tries to find a match comparing the passed `name` value with the `id` or `name` from the [`exchanges.json`](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/packages/common/src/metadata/exchanges.json)

```jsx
import { ExchangeIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'

// from exchanges.json:
// {
//   "id": "coinbase",
//   "name": "Coinbase",
//   "variants": ["branded", "mono", "background"],
//   "type": "cex"
// }

<ExchangeIcon name="coinbase" size={32} variant="branded" /> // matches the name
<ExchangeIcon name="coinbase" size={32} variant="mono" /> // matches the name
```

# Web3Icons

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/AGENTS.md

# Web3Icons

Web3 Icons is a monorepo providing comprehensive cryptocurrency, blockchain, and Web3-related icons as SVGs and React components. The project uses Bun as the package manager and Turbo for build orchestration.

## Common Commands

### Build Commands

```bash
# Build all packages and apps (runs turbo build + post-build)
bun build

# Build only packages (common, core, react)
bun build:packages

# Build individual packages
bun build:common    # Generates metadata TypeScript files from JSON
bun build:core      # Optimizes SVGs, generates index and svg-module
bun build:react     # Generates React components from SVGs

# Build apps
bun build:apps
bun build:website   # Next.js website
bun build:figma     # Figma plugin

# Post-build step (runs after main build)
bun post-build      # Runs generate-icons-md + format
```

### Development

```bash
# Start development mode (uses turbo dev)
bun dev

# Format code (Prettier)
bun format
```

### Icon Management

```bash
# Add new icons - detects git changes in raw-svgs/
bun add-icons

# Add metadata entry that references existing icons (e.g., testnets, wrapped tokens)
bun add-metadata

# Delete icons and their metadata
bun delete-icons

# Check for missing metadata
bun check-missing

# Validate SVG files
bun validate-svgs
bun validate-filenames
```

### Documentation

```bash
# Generate icons documentation (docs/icons.md)
bun generate-icons-md
```

### Publishing

```bash
# Sync to CDN (R2)
bun cdn:sync
```

## Architecture

### Monorepo Structure

```
web3icons/
├── packages/
│   ├── common/          # Shared metadata and types
│   ├── core/            # Optimized SVGs
│   └── react/           # React components
├── apps/
│   ├── website/         # Next.js website (web3icons.io)
│   └── figma-plugin/    # Figma plugin
├── scripts/             # Build scripts and CLI tools
└── raw-svgs/            # Source SVG files
```

### Package Dependencies

- `@web3icons/common`: Base package containing metadata (tokens.json, networks.json, wallets.json, exchanges.json) and TypeScript types
- `@web3icons/core`: Depends on `common`. Contains optimized SVGs in `src/svgs/`
- `@web3icons/react`: Depends on `common`. Contains generated React components

### Icon Types and Variants

**Types**: `token`, `network`, `wallet`, `exchange`

**Variants**: `branded` (color), `mono` (monochrome), `background` (tokens only)

### Build Process Flow

#### 1. Common Package Build

- Runs `scripts/build-scripts/generate-metadata.ts`
- Converts JSON metadata files to TypeScript files with type annotations
- Located in `packages/common/src/metadata/`

#### 2. Core Package Build

Pre-build steps (`scripts/build-scripts/core/core.pre-build.ts`):

1. **Order metadata**: Alphabetically sorts all metadata JSON files
2. **Optimize SVGs**: Processes raw-svgs/ → packages/core/src/svgs/
   - Applies SVGO optimization
   - Organizes by type and variant folders
3. **Generate svg-module.ts**: Creates import mappings for all SVGs
4. **Generate index.ts**: Exports all SVG assets

#### 3. React Package Build

Pre-build steps (`scripts/build-scripts/react/react.pre-build.ts`):

1. **Generate components**: Converts SVGs to React components using SVGR
   - Creates `Token{Symbol}`, `Network{Name}`, `Wallet{Name}`, `Exchange{Name}` components
   - Located in `packages/react/src/icons/`
2. **Generate index.ts**: Exports all React components

### Icon Workflow

1. **Add SVG files** to `raw-svgs/{type}/{variant}/` following naming conventions:
   - Tokens: UPPERCASE symbol (e.g., `BTC.svg`)
   - Networks/Wallets/Exchanges: kebab-case (e.g., `binance-smart-chain.svg`)
   - SVGs must be 24x24px frames (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

2. **Run `bun add-icons`**:
   - Detects git changes in raw-svgs/
   - Prompts for metadata (name, id, CoinGecko ID, etc.)
   - Adds entries to metadata JSON files
   - Or use `bun add-metadata` to reference existing icons

3. **Build packages**:
   - `bun build:packages` processes everything
   - SVGs are optimized and copied to core package
   - React components are auto-generated

### Metadata Structure

Metadata files are the source of truth stored as JSON in `packages/common/src/metadata/`. They are converted to TypeScript files during the common package build.

#### Token Metadata (`tokens.json`)

```json
{
  "id": "bitcoin",
  "filePath": "token:BTC",
  "symbol": "BTC",
  "name": "Bitcoin",
  "marketCapRank": 1,
  "addresses": {
    "ethereum": "0x2260fac5e5542a773aa44fbcfedf7c193bc2c599",
    "binance-smart-chain": "0x7130d2a12b9bcbfae4f2634d864a1ee1ce3ead9c"
  },
  "variants": ["branded", "mono", "background"]
}
```

**Fields**:

- `id`: Unique identifier (typically lowercase with hyphens)
- `filePath`: Icon reference in format `type:filename` (e.g., `token:BTC`)
  - **Icon Sharing System**: Multiple entries can reference the same SVG file
  - Example: Wrapped tokens can use `filePath: "token:ETH"` to share Ethereum's icon
  - Example: Testnets can use `filePath: "network:ethereum"` to share mainnet's icon
- `symbol`: Token ticker (uppercase, e.g., `BTC`, `ETH`)
- `name`: Full token name
- `marketCapRank`: Market cap ranking (null if not tracked)
- `addresses`: Object mapping network IDs to contract addresses
- `variants`: Array of available icon variants (`["branded", "mono", "background"]`)

#### Network Metadata (`networks.json`)

```json
{
  "id": "ethereum",
  "filePath": "network:ethereum",
  "chainId": 1,
  "caip2id": "eip155:1",
  "name": "Ethereum",
  "shortName": "ETH",
  "nativeCoinId": "ethereum",
  "variants": ["branded", "mono", "background"]
}
```

**Fields**:

- `id`: Network identifier (kebab-case)
- `filePath`: Icon reference (e.g., `network:ethereum`)
- `chainId`: EVM chain ID (if applicable, can be number or string)
- `caip2id`: CAIP-2 chain ID format (e.g., `eip155:1`)
- `name`: Full network name
- `shortName`: Abbreviated name
- `nativeCoinId`: Token ID of the native coin
- `variants`: Available icon variants

#### Wallet Metadata (`wallets.json`)

```json
{
  "id": "metamask",
  "filePath": "wallet:metamask",
  "name": "MetaMask",
  "variants": ["branded", "mono"]
}
```

**Fields**:

- `id`: Wallet identifier (kebab-case)
- `filePath`: Icon reference
- `name`: Display name
- `variants`: Available icon variants

#### Exchange Metadata (`exchanges.json`)

```json
{
  "id": "uniswap",
  "filePath": "exchange:uniswap",
  "name": "Uniswap",
  "type": "dex",
  "variants": ["branded", "mono"]
}
```

**Fields**:

- `id`: Exchange identifier (kebab-case)
- `filePath`: Icon reference
- `name`: Display name
- `type`: Either `"cex"` (centralized exchange) or `"dex"` (decentralized exchange)
- `variants`: Available icon variants

### Key Scripts

- `scripts/cli/add-icons.ts`: Interactive CLI for adding new icons (detects git changes in raw-svgs/)
- `scripts/cli/delete-icons.ts`: Remove icons and metadata
- `scripts/build-scripts/generate-metadata.ts`: Converts JSON metadata → TypeScript with type annotations
- `scripts/build-scripts/core/core-optimize-svgs.ts`: SVG optimization with SVGO + incremental build caching
- `scripts/build-scripts/core/core-generate-svgs-module.ts`: Generates svg-module.ts with all icon imports
- `scripts/build-scripts/react/react-generate-components.ts`: Converts SVGs → React components using SVGR
- `scripts/maintenance/generate-icons-md.ts`: Generates docs/icons.md documentation table
- `scripts/utils/svg-optimization.ts`: SVGO configuration and SVG processing utilities
- `scripts/utils/build-cache.ts`: Incremental build cache system for faster rebuilds

### Icon Naming Conventions

**File paths** (raw-svgs):

- `raw-svgs/tokens/{variant}/BTC.svg`
- `raw-svgs/networks/{variant}/ethereum.svg`
- `raw-svgs/wallets/{variant}/metamask.svg`

**React component names**:

- Tokens: `Token{SYMBOL}` → `TokenBTC`, `TokenETH`
- Networks: `Network{PascalCase}` → `NetworkEthereum`, `NetworkBinanceSmartChain`
- Wallets: `Wallet{PascalCase}` → `WalletMetamask`, `WalletRainbow`
- Exchanges: `Exchange{PascalCase}` → `ExchangeCoinbase`, `ExchangeBybit`

**Core SVG exports**:

- `svgs.tokens.brandedBTC` (camelCase)
- `svgs.networks.monoEthereum` (camelCase)

### Testing Changes

After making changes:

1. Run `bun build:packages` to rebuild affected packages
2. Check generated files:
   - `packages/common/src/metadata/*.ts`
   - `packages/core/src/svgs/`
   - `packages/react/src/icons/`
3. Run `bun format` before committing

### Important Notes

- Always add icons to `raw-svgs/` first, never directly to package src folders
- The build process is automated - manual edits to generated files will be overwritten
- Metadata JSON files in `packages/common/src/metadata/` are the source of truth
- Use `bun add-metadata` for entries that share icons with existing entries (e.g., testnets using mainnet icons, wrapped tokens)
- SVG optimization happens during core package build, using SVGO with custom config
- Incremental builds are enabled by default - only changed SVGs are re-optimized

## Advanced Topics

### Dynamic React Components

The React package provides dynamic components that automatically load the correct icon based on props. These are client-side only components (`'use client'` directive) and must be imported from the `/dynamic` entry point.

#### TokenIcon Component

```tsx
import { TokenIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'

// By symbol
<TokenIcon symbol="ETH" variant="branded" size={32} />

// By contract address + network
<TokenIcon
  address="0xc944e90c64b2c07662a292be6244bdf05cda44a7"
  network="ethereum"
  variant="mono"
  size={32}
/>

// With fallback
<TokenIcon
  symbol="UNKNOWN"
  fallback={<img src="/default.svg" />}
/>
```

**Lookup logic** (`packages/react/src/utils/find-metadata.ts`):

1. If `symbol` provided: Case-insensitive match on symbol field
2. If `address` + `network`: Matches contract address in addresses object
3. Returns `ITokenMetadata | undefined`

#### NetworkIcon Component

```tsx
import { NetworkIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'

// By name (matches id, name, or shortName - case insensitive)
<NetworkIcon name="Ethereum" variant="branded" size={32} />
<NetworkIcon name="bsc" /> // Matches shortName

// By chainId
<NetworkIcon chainId={1} variant="mono" />

// By CAIP-2 ID
<NetworkIcon caip2id="eip155:1" />
```

**Lookup logic**:

1. If `name`: Matches against `id` (kebab-case), `name`, or `shortName` (case-insensitive)
2. If `chainId`: Exact match on chainId field
3. If `caip2id`: Exact match on caip2id field
4. If `id`: Matches id or name

#### WalletIcon & ExchangeIcon

```tsx
import { WalletIcon, ExchangeIcon } from '@web3icons/react/dynamic'

<WalletIcon name="MetaMask" variant="branded" />
<WalletIcon id="metamask" /> // kebab-case id

<ExchangeIcon name="Uniswap" variant="mono" />
```

**Lookup logic**: Case-insensitive match on `id` (kebab-case) or `name`

### SVG Optimization Details

SVG optimization is handled by `scripts/build-scripts/core/core-optimize-svgs.ts` using SVGO:

**Configuration** (`scripts/utils/svg-optimization.ts`):

- `removeViewBox: false` - Preserves viewBox for proper scaling
- `prefixIds: true` - Prefixes IDs with icon name to prevent conflicts
- `multipass: true` - Multiple optimization passes for better compression
- `js2svg: { pretty: true }` - Pretty-printed output

**Optimizations applied**:

1. Remove unnecessary attributes and metadata
2. Minify paths and transforms
3. Merge paths where possible
4. Prefix all IDs to avoid conflicts when multiple SVGs are on the same page
5. Convert style strings to camelCase objects for JSX compatibility

**Incremental Build Cache**:

- Tracks file hashes to skip unchanged SVGs
- Dramatically speeds up rebuilds (only processes modified icons)
- Cache stored in `node_modules/.cache/web3icons/`
- Enable with env var or automatically enabled by default

### Icon Sharing System (filePath)

The `filePath` property enables multiple metadata entries to reference the same physical SVG files.

**Use cases**:

1. **Testnets**: Use mainnet icons

   ```json
   {
     "id": "sepolia",
     "filePath": "network:ethereum", // References ethereum.svg
     "name": "Sepolia Testnet",
     "chainId": 11155111
   }
   ```

2. **Wrapped tokens**: Use underlying token's icon

   ```json
   {
     "id": "wrapped-bitcoin",
     "filePath": "token:BTC", // References BTC.svg
     "symbol": "WBTC",
     "name": "Wrapped Bitcoin"
   }
   ```

3. **Token variants**: Multiple listings share same icon
   ```json
   {
     "id": "tether-bridged",
     "filePath": "token:USDT", // References USDT.svg
     "symbol": "USDT.e",
     "name": "Tether USD (Bridged)"
   }
   ```

**Format**: `{type}:{filename}` where:

- `type`: `token`, `network`, `wallet`, or `exchange`
- `filename`: The SVG filename without extension (e.g., `BTC`, `ethereum`, `metamask`)

### TypeScript Types

All metadata types are defined in `packages/common/src/types.ts`:

```typescript
type TVariant = 'branded' | 'mono' | 'background'
type TType = 'network' | 'token' | 'wallet' | 'exchange'
type TExchangeType = 'cex' | 'dex'

interface ITokenMetadata {
  id: string
  filePath: string
  symbol: string
  name: string
  marketCapRank: number | null
  addresses: { [key: string]: string | undefined }
  variants: TVariant[]
}

interface INetworkMetadata {
  id: string
  filePath: string
  name: string
  shortName?: string
  nativeCoinId?: string
  chainId?: number | string
  caip2id?: string
  variants: TVariant[]
}
```

### Common Workflows

#### Adding a New Token with Icon

1. Create SVG files in `raw-svgs/tokens/branded/` and/or `raw-svgs/tokens/mono/`
   - Filename: `{SYMBOL}.svg` (e.g., `BTC.svg`, `ETH.svg`)
   - Must be 24x24px frame (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
2. Run `bun add-icons`
3. CLI detects new files and prompts for metadata
4. Enter token name, ID, contract addresses, etc.
5. Run `bun build:packages` to generate components
6. Verify in `packages/core/src/svgs/tokens/` and `packages/react/src/icons/tokens/`

#### Adding a Testnet (Reusing Mainnet Icon)

1. Run `bun add-metadata`
2. Select "Network" as the type
3. Enter icon reference (e.g., `network:ethereum`)
4. Provide testnet details (name, chainId, etc.)
5. Build packages - testnet will use mainnet's icon

#### Updating Icon Files

1. Replace SVG in `raw-svgs/{type}/{variant}/`
2. Git will show modification
3. Run `bun build:core` to re-optimize
4. Incremental cache detects change and re-processes only that file

### Troubleshooting

**Icons not showing up after adding**:

- Ensure `bun build:packages` was run
- Check metadata JSON files in `packages/common/src/metadata/`
- Verify SVG files were copied to `packages/core/src/svgs/`
- Check React components generated in `packages/react/src/icons/`

**Build failing**:

- Run `bun format` to fix formatting issues
- Check SVG files are valid XML
- Ensure metadata JSON files are valid JSON
- Check for duplicate IDs in metadata files

**Dynamic components not working**:

- Remember they are client-side only (`'use client'`)
- Check lookup logic matches your props (case-insensitive, kebab-case conversions)
- Use fallback prop to handle missing icons gracefully

**Slow builds**:

- Incremental cache should be enabled automatically
- Clear cache: `rm -rf node_modules/.cache/web3icons/`
- Check if processing all SVGs vs. only changed ones in build output

---

# API Reference

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/apps/website/src/app/docs/content/common/api.mdx

title: API Reference
description: Complete API reference for @web3icons/common types and metadata
order: 2

# API Reference

Complete reference for all @web3icons/common exports.

## Type Exports

Import types from the main entry point:

```typescript
import {
  TVariant,
  TType,
  TTokenMetadata,
  TNetworkMetadata,
  TWalletMetadata,
  TExchangeMetadata,
} from '@web3icons/common'
```

### TVariant

Icon visual style variant.

```typescript
type TVariant = 'mono' | 'branded' | 'background'
```

| Value          | Description                            |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `'mono'`       | Monochromatic, single color            |
| `'branded'`    | Official brand colors                  |
| `'background'` | With circular background (tokens only) |

### TType

Icon category type.

```typescript
type TType = 'token' | 'network' | 'wallet' | 'exchange'
```

### TTokenMetadata

Token metadata structure.

```typescript
interface TTokenMetadata {
  id: string
  name: string
  symbol: string
  variants: TVariant[]
  addresses?: Record<string, string>
  marketCapRank?: number | null
}
```

| Property        | Type                     | Description                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | `string`                 | Unique identifier (e.g., `"bitcoin"`) |
| `name`          | `string`                 | Display name (e.g., `"Bitcoin"`)      |
| `symbol`        | `string`                 | Ticker symbol (e.g., `"BTC"`)         |
| `variants`      | `TVariant[]`             | Available icon variants               |
| `addresses`     | `Record<string, string>` | Contract addresses by network         |
| `marketCapRank` | `number \| null`         | Market cap ranking                    |

### TNetworkMetadata

Network metadata structure.

```typescript
interface TNetworkMetadata {
  id: string
  name: string
  shortName?: string
  chainId?: number | string
  caip2id?: string
  variants: TVariant[]
  nativeCoinId?: string
}
```

| Property       | Type               | Description                            |
| -------------- | ------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `id`           | `string`           | Unique identifier (e.g., `"ethereum"`) |
| `name`         | `string`           | Display name (e.g., `"Ethereum"`)      |
| `shortName`    | `string`           | Short name (e.g., `"ETH"`)             |
| `chainId`      | `number \| string` | EVM chain ID                           |
| `caip2id`      | `string`           | CAIP-2 identifier (e.g., `"eip155:1"`) |
| `variants`     | `TVariant[]`       | Available icon variants                |
| `nativeCoinId` | `string`           | ID of native coin token                |

### TWalletMetadata

Wallet metadata structure.

```typescript
interface TWalletMetadata {
  id: string
  name: string
  variants: TVariant[]
}
```

| Property   | Type         | Description                            |
| ---------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string`     | Unique identifier (e.g., `"metamask"`) |
| `name`     | `string`     | Display name (e.g., `"MetaMask"`)      |
| `variants` | `TVariant[]` | Available icon variants                |

### TExchangeMetadata

Exchange metadata structure.

```typescript
interface TExchangeMetadata {
  id: string
  name: string
  type: 'cex' | 'dex'
  variants: TVariant[]
}
```

| Property   | Type             | Description                           |
| ---------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string`         | Unique identifier (e.g., `"uniswap"`) |
| `name`     | `string`         | Display name (e.g., `"Uniswap"`)      |
| `type`     | `'cex' \| 'dex'` | Exchange type                         |
| `variants` | `TVariant[]`     | Available icon variants               |

## Metadata Exports

Import metadata from the metadata subpath:

```typescript
import {
  tokens,
  networks,
  wallets,
  exchanges,
} from '@web3icons/common/metadata'
```

`tokens`

```typescript
const tokens: TTokenMetadata[]

// Example entry
{
  id: 'bitcoin',
  name: 'Bitcoin',
  symbol: 'BTC',
  variants: ['mono', 'branded', 'background'],
  addresses: {
    ethereum: '0x2260fac5e5542a773aa44fbcfedf7c193bc2c599'
  },
  marketCapRank: 1
}
```

`networks`

```typescript
const networks: TNetworkMetadata[]

// Example entry
{
  id: 'ethereum',
  name: 'Ethereum',
  shortName: 'ETH',
  chainId: 1,
  caip2id: 'eip155:1',
  variants: ['mono', 'branded'],
  nativeCoinId: 'ethereum'
}
```

`wallets`

```typescript
const wallets: TWalletMetadata[]

// Example entry
{
  id: 'metamask',
  name: 'MetaMask',
  variants: ['mono', 'branded']
}
```

`exchanges`

```typescript
const exchanges: TExchangeMetadata[]

// Example entry
{
  id: 'uniswap',
  name: 'Uniswap',
  type: 'dex',
  variants: ['mono', 'branded']
}
```

## Subpath Imports

Import specific collections for tree-shaking:

```typescript
// Individual collection imports
```

## Utility Functions

Common patterns for working with metadata:

#### Find by ID

```typescript
const bitcoin = tokens.find((t) => t.id === 'bitcoin')
const ethereum = networks.find((n) => n.id === 'ethereum')
```

#### Find by Symbol

```typescript
const btc = tokens.find((t) => t.symbol === 'BTC')
const eth = tokens.find((t) => t.symbol === 'ETH')
```

#### Find by Chain ID

```typescript
const network = networks.find((n) => n.chainId === 137) // Polygon
```

#### Find by Contract Address

```typescript
function findTokenByAddress(address: string, network: string) {
  return tokens.find(
    (t) => t.addresses?.[network]?.toLowerCase() === address.toLowerCase(),
  )
}
```

#### Search by Name

```typescript
function searchTokens(query: string) {
  const q = query.toLowerCase()
  return tokens.filter(
    (t) =>
      t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || t.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q),
  )
}
```

![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40web3icons%2Freact?style=flat&label=%40web3icons%2Fcommon)

# @web3icons/common

Shared TypeScript types and metadata for all Web3 Icons packages. Use this package to access icon metadata, or build type-safe integrations.

## Installation

<InstallTabs pkg="@web3icons/common" />

> This package is included as a dependency of `@web3icons/react` and `@web3icons/core`. Install it directly only if you need standalone access to metadata or types.

## Metadata Access

Access comprehensive metadata for all icons:

```typescript
import {
  tokens,
  networks,
  wallets,
  exchanges,
} from '@web3icons/common/metadata'

// Find by symbol
const bitcoin = tokens.find((t) => t.symbol === 'BTC')
// { id: 'bitcoin', name: 'Bitcoin', symbol: 'BTC', ... }

// Find by chain ID
const ethereum = networks.find((n) => n.chainId === 1)
// { id: 'ethereum', name: 'Ethereum', chainId: 1, ... }
```

## TypeScript Types

Import types for building type-safe applications:

```typescript
import {
  TVariant, // 'mono' | 'branded' | 'background'
  TType, // 'token' | 'network' | 'wallet' | 'exchange'
  TTokenMetadata, // Token metadata structure
  TNetworkMetadata, // Network metadata structure
  TWalletMetadata, // Wallet metadata structure
  TExchangeMetadata, // Exchange metadata structure
} from '@web3icons/common'
```

## Metadata Interfaces

`TTokenMetadata`

```typescript
interface TTokenMetadata {
  id: string // "bitcoin"
  name: string // "Bitcoin"
  symbol: string // "BTC"
  variants: TVariant[] // ["mono", "branded", "background"]
  addresses?: Record<string, string> // Contract addresses by network
}
```

`TNetworkMetadata`

```typescript
interface TNetworkMetadata {
  id: string // "ethereum"
  name: string // "Ethereum"
  shortName?: string // "eth"
  chainId?: number // 1
  variants: TVariant[] // ["mono", "branded"]
  nativeCoinId?: string // "ethereum"
}
```

`TWalletMetadata`

```typescript
interface TWalletMetadata {
  id: string // "metamask"
  name: string // "MetaMask"
  variants: TVariant[] // ["mono", "branded"]
}
```

`TExchangeMetadata`

```typescript
interface TExchangeMetadata {
  id: string // "uniswap"
  name: string // "Uniswap"
  variants: TVariant[] // ["mono", "branded"]
  type: 'cex' | 'dex' // Exchange type
}
```

## Search and Filter

### Search Tokens

```typescript
function searchTokens(query: string) {
  const q = query.toLowerCase()
  return tokens.filter(
    (token) =>
      token.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      token.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q),
  )
}

// Usage
const results = searchTokens('bitcoin')
// [{ id: 'bitcoin', name: 'Bitcoin', symbol: 'BTC', ... }, ...]
```

### Find Network by Chain ID

```typescript
function getNetworkByChainId(chainId: number) {
  return networks.find((network) => network.chainId === chainId)
}

// Usage
const ethereum = getNetworkByChainId(1)
const polygon = getNetworkByChainId(137)
const arbitrum = getNetworkByChainId(42161)
```

### Find Token by Contract Address

```typescript
function getTokenByAddress(address: string, network: string) {
  return tokens.find(
    (token) =>
      token.addresses?.[network]?.toLowerCase() === address.toLowerCase(),
  )
}

// Usage
const usdc = getTokenByAddress(
  '0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48',
  'ethereum',
)
```

## Type-Safe Components

Build components with full type safety:

```typescript

interface TokenCardProps {
  token: TTokenMetadata
  variant: TVariant
  onClick: (token: TTokenMetadata) => void
}

function TokenCard({ token, variant, onClick }: TokenCardProps) {
  return (
    <button onClick={() => onClick(token)}>
      <span>{token.name} ({token.symbol})</span>
    </button>
  )
}
```

# API Reference

Complete reference for all @web3icons/core exports.

## SVG Collections

The main export providing access to all icons as data URLs.

```typescript
interface SvgCollections {
  tokens: Record<string, string>
  networks: Record<string, string>
  wallets: Record<string, string>
  exchanges: Record<string, string>
}
```

### tokens

Token icons keyed by `{variant}{SYMBOL}`:

```javascript
svgs.tokens.brandedBTC // Bitcoin branded
svgs.tokens.monoBTC // Bitcoin mono
svgs.tokens.backgroundBTC // Bitcoin with background

svgs.tokens.brandedETH // Ethereum branded
svgs.tokens.monoETH // Ethereum mono
svgs.tokens.backgroundETH // Ethereum with background
```

### networks

Network icons keyed by `{variant}{PascalCase}`:

```javascript
svgs.networks.brandedEthereum
svgs.networks.monoEthereum

svgs.networks.brandedPolygon
svgs.networks.monoPolygon

svgs.networks.brandedBinanceSmartChain
svgs.networks.monoBinanceSmartChain
```

### wallets

Wallet icons keyed by `{variant}{PascalCase}`:

```javascript
svgs.wallets.brandedMetamask
svgs.wallets.monoMetamask

svgs.wallets.brandedCoinbaseWallet
svgs.wallets.monoCoinbaseWallet

svgs.wallets.brandedRainbow
svgs.wallets.monoRainbow
```

### exchanges

Exchange icons keyed by `{variant}{PascalCase}`:

```javascript
svgs.exchanges.brandedUniswap
svgs.exchanges.monoUniswap

svgs.exchanges.brandedBinance
svgs.exchanges.monoBinance

svgs.exchanges.brandedCoinbase
svgs.exchanges.monoCoinbase
```

## Direct SVG Imports

Import individual SVG files for minimal bundle size:

### Token SVGs

```javascript
// Path: @web3icons/core/svgs/tokens/{variant}/{SYMBOL}.svg
```

### Network SVGs

```javascript
// Path: @web3icons/core/svgs/networks/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg
```

### Wallet SVGs

```javascript
// Path: @web3icons/core/svgs/wallets/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg
```

### Exchange SVGs

```javascript
// Path: @web3icons/core/svgs/exchanges/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg
```

## File Path Patterns

| Type     | Path Pattern                                 | Example                               |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Token    | `/svgs/tokens/{variant}/{SYMBOL}.svg`        | `/svgs/tokens/branded/BTC.svg`        |
| Network  | `/svgs/networks/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg`  | `/svgs/networks/branded/ethereum.svg` |
| Wallet   | `/svgs/wallets/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg`   | `/svgs/wallets/branded/metamask.svg`  |
| Exchange | `/svgs/exchanges/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg` | `/svgs/exchanges/branded/uniswap.svg` |

## Object Key Patterns

| Type     | Key Pattern             | Example                          |
| -------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Token    | `{variant}{SYMBOL}`     | `brandedBTC`, `monoETH`          |
| Network  | `{variant}{PascalCase}` | `brandedEthereum`, `monoPolygon` |
| Wallet   | `{variant}{PascalCase}` | `brandedMetamask`, `monoRainbow` |
| Exchange | `{variant}{PascalCase}` | `brandedUniswap`, `monoBinance`  |

## Variants

| Variant      | Description                 | Available For  |
| ------------ | --------------------------- | -------------- |
| `branded`    | Official brand colors       | All icon types |
| `mono`       | Monochromatic, single color | All icon types |
| `background` | Circular background         | Tokens only    |

## TypeScript Support

The package includes full TypeScript definitions:

```typescript
// Type-safe access
const btc: string = svgs.tokens.brandedBTC

// Dynamic access with type assertion
function getToken(symbol: string, variant: 'branded' | 'mono' = 'branded') {
  const key = `${variant}${symbol.toUpperCase()}` as keyof typeof svgs.tokens
  return svgs.tokens[key]
}
```

# @web3icons/core

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/apps/website/src/app/docs/content/core/quick-start.mdx

title: Quick Start
description: Framework-agnostic SVG icons for any JavaScript project
order: 1

![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40web3icons%2Freact?style=flat&label=%40web3icons%2Fcore)

# @web3icons/core

Framework-agnostic package providing direct access to SVG files. Works with vanilla JavaScript, Vue, Angular, Svelte, or any web project.

## Installation

<InstallTabs pkg="@web3icons/core" />

## SVG Imports

Access icons as data URLs through the `svgs` object:

```javascript
// Token icons
const bitcoinIcon = svgs.tokens.brandedBTC
const ethereumIcon = svgs.tokens.monoETH

// Network icons
const polygonIcon = svgs.networks.brandedPolygon

// Wallet icons
const metamaskIcon = svgs.wallets.brandedMetamask

// Exchange icons
const uniswapIcon = svgs.exchanges.brandedUniswap
```

## Using in HTML

```javascript
// Set as image source
document.getElementById('btc-icon').src = svgs.tokens.brandedBTC

// Create dynamic elements
const img = document.createElement('img')
img.src = svgs.tokens.brandedETH
img.width = 32
img.height = 32
img.alt = 'Ethereum'
document.body.appendChild(img)
```

## Icon Categories

| Category  | Count  | Example Keys                               |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------ |
| Tokens    | 2,000+ | `brandedBTC`, `monoETH`, `backgroundUSDC`  |
| Networks  | 150+   | `brandedEthereum`, `monoBinanceSmartChain` |
| Wallets   | 50+    | `brandedMetamask`, `monoCoinbaseWallet`    |
| Exchanges | 40+    | `brandedUniswap`, `monoBinance`            |

## Variants

All icons come in multiple visual styles:

```javascript
// Mono - Monochromatic, single color
svgs.tokens.monoBTC

// Branded - Official brand colors
svgs.tokens.brandedBTC

// Background - With circular background (tokens only)
svgs.tokens.backgroundBTC
```

## Naming Conventions

### Object Keys

Icons in the `svgs` object follow this pattern:

| Type      | Pattern                 | Examples                                   |
| --------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Tokens    | `{variant}{SYMBOL}`     | `brandedBTC`, `monoETH`                    |
| Networks  | `{variant}{PascalCase}` | `brandedEthereum`, `monoBinanceSmartChain` |
| Wallets   | `{variant}{PascalCase}` | `brandedMetamask`, `monoCoinbaseWallet`    |
| Exchanges | `{variant}{PascalCase}` | `brandedUniswap`, `monoBinance`            |

### Direct File Paths

You can also import SVG files directly:

```javascript
// Tokens: /svgs/tokens/{variant}/{SYMBOL}.svg

// Networks: /svgs/networks/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg

// Wallets: /svgs/wallets/{variant}/{kebab-case}.svg
```

## Dynamic Loading

Load icons on demand for better initial bundle size:

```javascript
async function loadIcon(symbol, variant = 'branded') {
  try {
    const module = await import(
      `@web3icons/core/svgs/tokens/${variant}/${symbol.toUpperCase()}.svg`
    )
    return module.default
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(`Icon not found: ${symbol}`)
    return null
  }
}

// Usage
const btcIcon = await loadIcon('btc')
const ethIcon = await loadIcon('eth', 'mono')
```

## Helper Function

Create a utility for safe icon access with fallbacks:

```javascript
function getTokenIcon(symbol, variant = 'branded') {
  const key = `${variant}${symbol.toUpperCase()}`
  return svgs.tokens[key] || null
}

// Usage with fallback
const icon = getTokenIcon('btc') || '/fallback-icon.svg'
```

## TypeScript

Full TypeScript support included:

```typescript
interface TokenDisplay {
  token: TTokenMetadata
  size: number
}

function createIcon({ token, size }: TokenDisplay) {
  const key = `branded${token.symbol}` as keyof typeof svgs.tokens
  const img = document.createElement('img')
  img.src = svgs.tokens[key]
  img.width = size
  return img
}
```

# Contributing

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/apps/website/src/app/docs/content/guides/contributing.mdx

title: Contributing
description: How to contribute icons and code to Web3 Icons
order: 99

# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Web3 Icons! This guide covers how to add new icons, update existing ones, and contribute to the codebase.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons.git
cd web3icons

# Install dependencies (uses Bun)
bun install

# Build all packages
bun build:packages
```

## Adding New Icons

### 1. Prepare SVG Files

Create your SVG files following these specifications:

| Requirement | Value       |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| Canvas size | 24×24 px    |
| Viewbox     | `0 0 24 24` |
| Format      | SVG         |

**Naming conventions:**

- **Tokens**: UPPERCASE symbol (e.g., `BTC.svg`, `ETH.svg`)
- **Networks**: kebab-case (e.g., `ethereum.svg`, `binance-smart-chain.svg`)
- **Wallets**: kebab-case (e.g., `metamask.svg`, `coinbase-wallet.svg`)
- **Exchanges**: kebab-case (e.g., `uniswap.svg`, `binance.svg`)

### 2. Add SVG Files

Place your SVG files in the `raw-svgs/` directory:

```
raw-svgs/
├── tokens/
│   ├── branded/       # brand colors, official version
│   │   └── BTC.svg
│   ├── mono/          # monochrome svg must be in #ffffff
│   │   └── BTC.svg
│   └── background/    # with background
│       └── BTC.svg
├── networks/
│   ├── branded/
│   │   └── ethereum.svg
│   └── mono/
│       └── ethereum.svg
├── wallets/
│   ├── branded/
│   │   └── metamask.svg
│   └── mono/
│       └── metamask.svg
└── exchanges/
    ├── branded/
    │   └── uniswap.svg
    └── mono/
        └── uniswap.svg
```

### 3. Run the Add Icons Script

```bash
bun add-icons
```

The CLI will:

1. Detect new SVG files in `raw-svgs/`
2. Prompt for metadata (name, ID, contract addresses, etc.)
3. Add entries to the metadata JSON files

### 4. Build and Verify

```bash
# Build all packages
bun build:packages
```

Verify your icons appear in:

- `packages/core/src/svgs/` (optimized SVGs)
- `packages/react/src/icons/` (React components)

## Icon Variants

Each icon can have up to three variants:

| Variant      | Description                           | Required    |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `branded`    | Official brand colors                 | Recommended |
| `mono`       | Single color, inherits `currentColor` | Recommended |
| `background` | with background                       | Yes         |

## Metadata Structure

### Token Metadata

```json
{
  "id": "bitcoin",
  "filePath": "token:BTC",
  "symbol": "BTC",
  "name": "Bitcoin",
  "marketCapRank": 1,
  "addresses": {
    "ethereum": "0x2260fac5e5542a773aa44fbcfedf7c193bc2c599",
    "binance-smart-chain": "0x7130d2a12b9bcbfae4f2634d864a1ee1ce3ead9c"
  },
  "variants": ["branded", "mono", "background"]
}
```

### Network Metadata

```json
{
  "id": "ethereum",
  "filePath": "network:ethereum",
  "chainId": 1,
  "caip2id": "eip155:1",
  "name": "Ethereum",
  "shortName": "ETH",
  "nativeCoinId": "ethereum",
  "variants": ["branded", "mono"]
}
```

### Wallet Metadata

```json
{
  "id": "metamask",
  "filePath": "wallet:metamask",
  "name": "MetaMask",
  "variants": ["branded", "mono"]
}
```

### Exchange Metadata

```json
{
  "id": "uniswap",
  "filePath": "exchange:uniswap",
  "name": "Uniswap",
  "type": "dex",
  "variants": ["branded", "mono"]
}
```

## Sharing Icons (filePath)

Multiple metadata entries can reference the same SVG file using `filePath`:

```json
// Wrapped Bitcoin uses Bitcoin's icon
{
  "id": "wrapped-bitcoin",
  "filePath": "token:BTC",
  "symbol": "WBTC",
  "name": "Wrapped Bitcoin"
}

// Sepolia testnet uses Ethereum's icon
{
  "id": "sepolia",
  "filePath": "network:ethereum",
  "name": "Sepolia Testnet",
  "chainId": 11155111
}
```

Use `bun add-metadata` to add entries that share existing icons.

## CLI Commands

| Command                  | Description                                      |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `bun add-icons`          | Add new icons (detects git changes in raw-svgs/) |
| `bun add-metadata`       | Add metadata for existing icons (icon sharing)   |
| `bun delete-icons`       | Remove icons and their metadata                  |
| `bun check-missing`      | Find icons without metadata                      |
| `bun validate-svgs`      | Validate SVG files                               |
| `bun validate-filenames` | Check filename conventions                       |

## Build Commands

| Command              | Description                               |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `bun run build`      | Build all packages and apps               |
| `bun build:packages` | Build only packages (common, core, react) |
| `bun build:common`   | Generate metadata TypeScript from JSON    |
| `bun build:core`     | Optimize SVGs, generate exports           |
| `bun build:react`    | Generate React components                 |
| `bun format`         | Format code with Prettier                 |

## SVG Guidelines

### Do

- Use a 24×24px viewBox
- Keep file size minimal
- Use paths instead of shapes where possible
- Center the icon within the frame

### Don't

- Include embedded fonts
- Use external references
- Include JavaScript
- Include unnecessary metadata

### Optimization

SVGs are automatically optimized during build using SVGO:

- Removes unnecessary metadata
- Minifies paths and transforms
- Prefixes IDs to prevent conflicts
- Converts styles for React compatibility

## Testing Your Changes

```bash
# Build packages
bun build:packages

# Start the website dev server
bun dev

# Check generated files
ls packages/core/src/svgs/tokens/branded/
ls packages/react/src/icons/tokens/
```

## Submitting Changes

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b add-new-icon`
3. Add your icons and metadata
4. Build and test: `bun build:packages`
5. Format: `bun format`
6. Commit: `git commit -m "Add XYZ token icon"`
7. Push and create a Pull Request

## Getting Help

- [Open an issue](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/issues) for bugs or feature requests
- Check existing icons in `raw-svgs/` for reference
- Review the metadata files in `packages/common/src/metadata/`

## Repository Structure

```
web3icons/
├── packages/
│   ├── common/          # Metadata and TypeScript types
│   ├── core/            # Optimized SVGs
│   └── react/           # React components
├── apps/
│   ├── website/         # website
│   └── figma-plugin/    # Figma plugin
├── scripts/             # Build scripts and CLI tools
├── raw-svgs/            # Source SVG files (add icons here)
```

By contributing, you agree that your contributions will be licensed under the MIT License.

# Next.js Integration

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/apps/website/src/app/docs/content/guides/nextjs.mdx

title: Next.js
description: Using web3icons with Next.js App Router and Pages Router
order: 1

# Next.js Integration

Complete guide for using @web3icons/react with Next.js 13+ App Router and Pages Router.

## Installation

<InstallTabs pkg="@web3icons/react" />

## App Router (Recommended)

### Server Components

Individual icon components work directly in Server Components:

```tsx
// app/page.tsx (Server Component)

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <TokenBTC size={32} variant="branded" />
      <TokenETH size={32} variant="branded" />
      <NetworkEthereum size={32} variant="branded" />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Client Components

Dynamic components require the `'use client'` directive:

```tsx
// app/components/token-display.tsx
'use client'

interface Props {
  symbol: string
}

export function TokenDisplay({ symbol }: Props) {
  return <TokenIcon symbol={symbol} size={32} variant="branded" />
}
```

```tsx
// app/page.tsx

export default function Page() {
  return <TokenDisplay symbol="BTC" />
}
```

### Hybrid Approach

Combine server and client components for optimal performance:

```tsx
// app/portfolio/page.tsx

// Static icons render on the server
// Dynamic list is a client component
export default function Portfolio() {
  return (
    <div>
      <header className="flex gap-2">
        <TokenBTC size={24} variant="branded" />
        <TokenETH size={24} variant="branded" />
      </header>
      <TokenList />
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// app/portfolio/token-list.tsx
'use client'

export function TokenList() {
  const tokens = useUserTokens()

  return (
    <ul>
      {tokens.map((token) => (
        <li key={token.symbol} className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <TokenIcon symbol={token.symbol} size={24} variant="branded" />
          <span>{token.name}</span>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}
```

## Pages Router

All components work in Pages Router without special configuration:

```tsx
// pages/index.tsx

export default function Home() {
  return (
    <div>
      {/* Static imports */}
      <TokenBTC size={32} variant="branded" />
      <TokenETH size={32} variant="branded" />

      {/* Dynamic import */}
      <TokenIcon symbol="USDC" size={32} variant="branded" />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Code Splitting

### Lazy Load Dynamic Icons

Split the dynamic icon bundle from your main bundle:

```tsx
'use client'

const TokenIcon = lazy(() =>
  import('@web3icons/react/dynamic').then((mod) => ({
    default: mod.TokenIcon,
  })),
)

function IconSkeleton() {
  return <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-gray-200" />
}

export function LazyTokenIcon({ symbol }: { symbol: string }) {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<IconSkeleton />}>
      <TokenIcon symbol={symbol} size={32} variant="branded" />
    </Suspense>
  )
}
```

### Route-Based Splitting

Dynamic icons in client components are automatically code-split per route:

```tsx
// app/wallet/page.tsx
'use client'

// This chunk only loads when /wallet is visited
export default function WalletPage() {
  const assets = useWalletAssets()
  return assets.map((a) => <TokenIcon key={a.symbol} symbol={a.symbol} />)
}
```

## Bundle Optimization

### Analyze Bundle Size

```bash
# Add bundle analyzer
npm install @next/bundle-analyzer

# next.config.js
const withBundleAnalyzer = require('@next/bundle-analyzer')({
  enabled: process.env.ANALYZE === 'true',
})
module.exports = withBundleAnalyzer({})

# Run analysis
ANALYZE=true npm run build
```

### Optimal Import Patterns

```tsx
// ✅ - tree-shakeable, minimal bundle

// ✅ - only load when needed

// ❌ - imports entire icon library
```

## SSR Considerations

Individual icon components are fully SSR-compatible and render on the server.

Dynamic components are client-only and will:

1. Render nothing during SSR
2. Hydrate on the client
3. Display the icon after hydration

Handle the hydration gap with fallbacks:

```tsx
'use client'

export function Token({ symbol }: { symbol: string }) {
  return (
    <TokenIcon
      symbol={symbol}
      size={32}
      variant="branded"
      fallback={<div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-gray-100" />}
    />
  )
}
```

## Image Optimization

For using icons as images with Next.js Image component:

```tsx
export function TokenImage({ symbol }: { symbol: string }) {
  const key = `branded${symbol.toUpperCase()}` as keyof typeof svgs.tokens
  const src = svgs.tokens[key]

  return <Image src={src} alt={symbol} width={32} height={32} />
}
```

## TypeScript Configuration

No additional TypeScript configuration is needed. The packages include full type definitions.

```typescript
// Types are automatically inferred

type TokenBTCProps = ComponentProps<typeof TokenBTC>
// { size?: number | string; variant?: 'mono' | 'branded' | 'background'; ... }
```

## Common Patterns

### Token Display Component

```tsx
'use client'

interface TokenDisplayProps {
  symbol: string
  name: string
  balance: string
}

export function TokenDisplay({ symbol, name, balance }: TokenDisplayProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
      <TokenIcon symbol={symbol} size={40} variant="branded" />
      <div>
        <div className="font-semibold">{name}</div>
        <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
          {balance} {symbol}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Network Selector

```tsx
'use client'

const networks = [
  { chainId: 1, name: 'Ethereum' },
  { chainId: 137, name: 'Polygon' },
  { chainId: 42161, name: 'Arbitrum' },
]

export function NetworkSelector({
  onSelect,
}: {
  onSelect: (chainId: number) => void
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      {networks.map((network) => (
        <button
          key={network.chainId}
          onClick={() => onSelect(network.chainId)}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border p-2 hover:bg-gray-50"
        >
          <NetworkIcon chainId={network.chainId} size={24} variant="branded" />
          <span>{network.name}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

# Remix Integration

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/apps/website/src/app/docs/content/guides/remix.mdx

title: Remix
description: Using web3icons with Remix
order: 3

# Remix Integration

Set up @web3icons/react with Remix for full-stack React applications.

## Installation

<InstallTabs pkg="@web3icons/react" />

## Basic Setup

Import and use icons in your routes:

```tsx
// app/routes/_index.tsx

export default function Index() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <TokenBTC size={32} variant="branded" />
      <TokenETH size={32} variant="branded" />
      <NetworkEthereum size={32} variant="branded" />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Server vs Client Rendering

### Static Icons (Server-Safe)

Individual icon components render on the server without issues:

```tsx
// app/routes/tokens.tsx

export default function Tokens() {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
        <TokenBTC size={48} variant="branded" />
        <span>Bitcoin</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
        <TokenETH size={48} variant="branded" />
        <span>Ethereum</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
        <TokenUSDC size={48} variant="branded" />
        <span>USDC</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Dynamic Icons (Client-Only)

Dynamic components require client-side rendering:

```tsx
// app/components/token-icon-client.tsx

interface Props {
  symbol: string
  size?: number
}

export function TokenIconClient({ symbol, size = 32 }: Props) {
  return <TokenIcon symbol={symbol} size={size} variant="branded" />
}
```

```tsx
// app/routes/portfolio.tsx

export default function Portfolio() {
  const tokens = ['BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL', 'AVAX']

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
      {tokens.map((symbol) => (
        <ClientOnly key={symbol} fallback={<IconPlaceholder />}>
          {() => <TokenIconClient symbol={symbol} />}
        </ClientOnly>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function IconPlaceholder() {
  return <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-gray-200" />
}
```

## With Loaders

Combine with Remix loaders for dynamic data:

```tsx
// app/routes/wallet.$address.tsx

interface Asset {
  symbol: string
  name: string
  balance: string
}

export async function loader({ params }: LoaderFunctionArgs) {
  const assets = await fetchWalletAssets(params.address!)
  return json({ assets })
}

export default function Wallet() {
  const { assets } = useLoaderData<typeof loader>()

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {assets.map((asset) => (
        <div
          key={asset.symbol}
          className="flex items-center gap-4 border-b pb-4"
        >
          <TokenIcon symbol={asset.symbol} size={40} variant="branded" />
          <div>
            <div className="font-semibold">{asset.name}</div>
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">
              {asset.balance} {asset.symbol}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Metadata and Types

Use @web3icons/common for type-safe development:

```tsx
// app/routes/api.tokens.tsx

export async function loader() {
  // Filter and transform metadata on the server
  const topTokens = tokens
    .filter(
      (t): t is TTokenMetadata & { marketCapRank: number } =>
        t.marketCapRank !== null && t.marketCapRank <= 100,
    )
    .sort((a, b) => a.marketCapRank - b.marketCapRank)
    .slice(0, 20)

  return json({ tokens: topTokens })
}
```

## Using @web3icons/core

For image-based rendering:

```tsx
// app/routes/icons.tsx

export default function Icons() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <img src={svgs.tokens.brandedBTC} alt="Bitcoin" width={32} height={32} />
      <img src={svgs.tokens.brandedETH} alt="Ethereum" width={32} height={32} />
      <img
        src={svgs.networks.brandedPolygon}
        alt="Polygon"
        width={32}
        height={32}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Bundle Configuration

### Optimize Server Bundle

Add to remix.config.js if needed:

```javascript
// remix.config.js
module.exports = {
  serverDependenciesToBundle: [
    // Usually not needed, but if you encounter issues:
    // '@web3icons/react',
  ],
}
```

### Analyze Bundle Size

```bash
# Build with stats
npx remix build --sourcemap

# Analyze
npx source-map-explorer build/client/**/*.js
```

## Example: Network Switcher

```tsx
// app/components/network-switcher.tsx

const networks = [
  { chainId: 1, name: 'Ethereum', network: 'ethereum' },
  { chainId: 137, name: 'Polygon', network: 'polygon' },
  { chainId: 42161, name: 'Arbitrum', network: 'arbitrum' },
  { chainId: 10, name: 'Optimism', network: 'optimism' },
  { chainId: 8453, name: 'Base', network: 'base' },
]

interface Props {
  currentChainId: number
  onSwitch: (chainId: number) => void
}

export function NetworkSwitcher({ currentChainId, onSwitch }: Props) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
  const current =
    networks.find((n) => n.chainId === currentChainId) || networks[0]

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2"
      >
        <NetworkIcon chainId={current.chainId} size={20} variant="branded" />
        <span>{current.name}</span>
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-48 rounded-lg border bg-white shadow-lg">
          {networks.map((network) => (
            <button
              key={network.chainId}
              onClick={() => {
                onSwitch(network.chainId)
                setIsOpen(false)
              }}
              className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 hover:bg-gray-50 ${
                network.chainId === currentChainId ? 'bg-blue-50' : ''
              }`}
            >
              <NetworkIcon
                chainId={network.chainId}
                size={20}
                variant="branded"
              />
              <span>{network.name}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Example: Token Search

```tsx
// app/routes/search.tsx

export async function loader({ request }: { request: Request }) {
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const query = url.searchParams.get('q')?.toLowerCase() || ''

  const results = query
    ? tokens
        .filter(
          (t) =>
            t.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(query),
        )
        .slice(0, 20)
    : []

  return json({ results })
}

export default function Search() {
  const { results } = useLoaderData<typeof loader>()
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()
  const query = searchParams.get('q') || ''

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-lg p-4">
      <Form method="get" className="mb-6">
        <input
          type="text"
          name="q"
          defaultValue={query}
          placeholder="Search tokens..."
          className="w-full rounded-lg border px-4 py-2"
        />
      </Form>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        {results.map((token) => (
          <div
            key={token.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3"
          >
            <TokenIcon symbol={token.symbol} size={32} variant="branded" />
            <div>
              <div className="font-semibold">{token.symbol}</div>
              <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">{token.name}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Hydration Tips

To avoid hydration mismatches with dynamic icons:

1. Use `ClientOnly` from remix-utils for dynamic components
2. Provide consistent fallback placeholders
3. Use static icons for critical above-the-fold content

```tsx
// Recommended pattern

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Hero - uses static icons for fast paint */}
      <header>
        <TokenBTC size={48} variant="branded" />
      </header>

      {/* Below fold - dynamic icons are fine */}
      <main>
        <TokenIcon symbol={userSelectedToken} size={32} variant="branded" />
      </main>
    </>
  )
}
```

# Vite Integration

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/apps/website/src/app/docs/content/guides/vite.mdx

description: Using web3icons with Vite and React
order: 2

# Vite Integration

Set up @web3icons/react or @web3icons/core with Vite for fast development and optimized builds.

## Installation

<InstallTabs pkg="@web3icons/react" />

## Basic Setup

No additional configuration required. Import and use directly:

```tsx
// src/App.tsx

function App() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-4">
      <TokenBTC size={32} variant="branded" />
      <TokenETH size={32} variant="branded" />
      <NetworkEthereum size={32} variant="branded" />
    </div>
  )
}

export default App
```

## Dynamic Icons

Use dynamic components for runtime icon selection:

```tsx
// src/components/TokenDisplay.tsx

interface Props {
  symbol: string
}

export function TokenDisplay({ symbol }: Props) {
  return <TokenIcon symbol={symbol} size={32} variant="branded" />
}
```

```tsx
// src/App.tsx

function App() {
  const tokens = ['BTC', 'ETH', 'USDC', 'SOL']

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4">
      {tokens.map((symbol) => (
        <TokenDisplay key={symbol} symbol={symbol} />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Using @web3icons/core

For non-React usage or vanilla JavaScript:

```tsx
// src/App.tsx

function App() {
  return (
    <div>
      <img src={svgs.tokens.brandedBTC} alt="Bitcoin" width={32} height={32} />
      <img
        src={svgs.networks.brandedEthereum}
        alt="Ethereum"
        width={32}
```

## Bundle Optimization

### Analyze Bundle

```bash
# Install visualizer
npm install -D rollup-plugin-visualizer

# Or use npx
npx vite-bundle-visualizer
```

Add to vite.config.ts for build-time analysis:

```typescript
// vite.config.ts

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    react(),
    visualizer({
      open: true,
      gzipSize: true,
    }),
  ],
})
```

### Optimal Imports

```tsx
// ✅ - tree-shakeable

// ✅ - for dynamic use cases

// ❌ Avoid - imports everything
```

## Code Splitting

### Lazy Load Dynamic Icons

```tsx
const TokenIcon = lazy(() =>
  import('@web3icons/react/dynamic').then((mod) => ({
    default: mod.TokenIcon,
  })),
)

function TokenList({ symbols }: { symbols: string[] }) {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div>Loading icons...</div>}>
      {symbols.map((symbol) => (
        <TokenIcon key={symbol} symbol={symbol} size={24} variant="branded" />
      ))}
    </Suspense>
  )
}
```

### Manual Chunks

Configure Vite to separate icon bundles:

```typescript
// vite.config.ts

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  build: {
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks: {
          web3icons: ['@web3icons/react'],
          'web3icons-dynamic': ['@web3icons/react/dynamic'],
        },
      },
    },
  },
})
```

## TypeScript Configuration

Types work out of the box. No additional configuration needed:

```typescript
// Types are inferred automatically

type IconProps = ComponentProps<typeof TokenBTC>
```

## SVG Handling

Vite handles SVG imports automatically. For direct SVG file imports:

```typescript
// vite.config.ts

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  assetsInclude: ['**/*.svg'],
})
```

```tsx
// Direct SVG import

function App() {
  return <img src={btcIcon} alt="Bitcoin" />
}
```

## Development Performance

Vite's dev server handles @web3icons efficiently. For larger projects:

```typescript
// vite.config.ts

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  optimizeDeps: {
    include: ['@web3icons/react', '@web3icons/common'],
  },
})
```

## Example: Token Selector

Complete example of a token selector component:

```tsx
// src/components/TokenSelector.tsx

export function TokenSelector() {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const filtered = tokens
    .filter(
      (t) =>
        t.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
        t.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()),
    )
    .slice(0, 20)

  return (
    <div className="w-80 rounded-lg border p-4">
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder="Search tokens..."
        value={search}
        onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
        className="mb-4 w-full rounded border px-3 py-2"
      />
      <div className="max-h-64 overflow-auto">
        {filtered.map((token) => (
          <button
            key={token.id}
            onClick={() => setSelected(token.symbol)}
            className={`flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded p-2 hover:bg-gray-50 ${
              selected === token.symbol ? 'bg-blue-50' : ''
            }`}
          >
            <TokenIcon symbol={token.symbol} size={32} variant="branded" />
            <div className="text-left">
              <div className="font-medium">{token.symbol}</div>
              <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">{token.name}</div>
            </div>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Example: Wallet Balance

```tsx
// src/components/WalletBalance.tsx

interface Asset {
  symbol: string
  name: string
  balance: string
  network: string
}

export function WalletBalance({ assets }: { assets: Asset[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {assets.map((asset) => (
        <div
          key={`${asset.network}-${asset.symbol}`}
          className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-4"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="relative">
              <TokenIcon symbol={asset.symbol} size={40} variant="branded" />
              <NetworkIcon
                network={asset.network}
                size={16}
                variant="branded"
                className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 rounded-full border-2 border-white"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="font-semibold">{asset.name}</div>
              <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">{asset.network}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right">
            <div className="font-mono">{asset.balance}</div>
            <div className="text-sm text-gray-500">{asset.symbol}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

# Web3 Icons

Source: https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons/blob/main/apps/website/src/app/docs/content/home.mdx

title: Web3 Icons
description: Complete library of crypto icons for tokens, networks, wallets, and exchanges
order: 0

# Web3 Icons

The most complete library of cryptocurrency, blockchain network, wallet, and exchange icons.

**2,500+ icons** across multiple variants and formats.

## Quick Start

<InstallTabs pkg="@web3icons/react" />

```jsx
function App() {
  return (
    <div>
      <TokenBTC size={32} variant="branded" />
      <NetworkEthereum size={32} variant="branded" />
      <WalletMetamask size={32} variant="branded" />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Packages

| Package                           | Description                              |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| [@web3icons/react](/docs/react)   | React components with TypeScript support |
| [@web3icons/core](/docs/core)     | Framework-agnostic SVG files             |
| [@web3icons/common](/docs/common) | TypeScript types and metadata            |

## Icon Types

- `Tokens` (2,000+): BTC, ETH, USDC, and more
- `Networks` (150+): Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum
- `Wallets` (50+): MetaMask, Coinbase, Rainbow, Ledger
- `Exchanges` (40+): Uniswap, Binance, Coinbase, PancakeSwap

## Variants

- `mono`: Monochromatic, inherits text color
- `branded`: Official brand colors
- `background`: Icons with circular backgrounds

## Features

- Tree-shakeable packages
- TypeScript support
- Multiple icon variants
- Optimized SVGs

## Community

- **GitHub**: [github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons](https://github.com/0xa3k5/web3icons)
- **npm**: [@web3icons/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@web3icons/react)
- **Figma**: [Web3 Icons Plugin](https://figma.com/community/plugin/1170720285035693761)
